mcq_drop.why: trivial: four statements all saying 'associated with Revolutionary Movement'
oddly worded mix of Gandhi and Bismil; no exam frames it so

pyq_bad.why: wrong options: match list collapsed to single names
suspect key: 'Sarfaroshi ki Tamanna' is linked to Ram Prasad Bismil, not Azad

patterns: APPSC asks direct who-did-what: HSRA founder = Bhagat Singh (y1fdd0e0db23), 'Why I am an Atheist' = Bhagat Singh, executed with him = Sukhdev and Rajguru.
Other PSCs repeat: Chittagong = Surya Sen, Kakori escapee = Azad, Jatin Das hunger strike death, Bismil hanged at Gorakhpur.
Traps: Bhagat Singh not at Kakori; B.K. Dutt not hanged; Saunders killed instead of Scott; HSRA 1928 (HRA 1924).
App adds multi-statement and chronology items (Naujawan Bharat Sabha, Assembly bills) - deeper than the PYQs but sound.
